user.description: Set up the OSRS Data integration to receive RuneLite notifications.

pair.title: Pair RuneLite Client
pair.description:
Your pairing code is:

## {code}

Click **Submit**, then enter this code in your RuneLite plugin within {ttl_minutes} minutes.

You can pair additional clients later from the integration options.

init.title: OSRS Data Options
init.description: Choose what you'd like to do.

pair_client.title: Pair New RuneLite Client
pair_client.description: Enter a name for the new RuneLite client.

pair_code.title: Pairing Code

settings.title: Integration Settings
settings.description: Tune history retention, deduplication, and presence detection. Changes take effect immediately (the integration reloads).

data.default_limit: Default history entries kept (other event types)

create_pairing_code.name: Create pairing code
create_pairing_code.description: Generate a 5-digit one-time pairing code for a RuneLite client. The code expires after 5 minutes.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: A friendly name for the RuneLite client being paired.

get_history.name: Get event history
get_history.description: Return recent game events (deaths, loot, level-ups, etc.) from the persistent history buffers, newest first.

account_name.name: Account name
account_name.description: Limit results to a single player. Leave empty for all accounts.

event_type.name: Event type
event_type.description: Limit results to one event type (e.g. DEATH, LOOT). Leave empty for all types.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.
